items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: in the band was Kid Ory, Barney Bigard, Charlie Beal, Bud Scott and myself, Minor Hall playing drums

ctx.x: You were saying, I believe, when we were looking at the Armstrong section of the discography, that they had a date wrong, a year wrong?

Yeah, they have it listed here as October 17, 1946. But it was October 17, 1947. That was the date after the picture with Louis Armstrong, the picture New Orleans, and in the band was Kid Ory, Barney Bigard, Charlie Beal, Bud Scott and myself, Minor Hall playing drums, of
